sources.title: Aldjia Algerian Name Transcription Corpus: paired French-family-name and Arabic-family-name columns; administrative student sample
sources.romanization_convention: Use original familyname_fr administrative transcription with title-case presentation; no algorithmic Arabic romanization
sources.limitations: Exclude rows contaminated by personal forenames or non-surname compounds; further manual attestation audit required
sources.expansion_selection: Preserve 500 legacy values verbatim. Append new unique single-token familyname_fr values explicitly paired to Arabic familyname_ar in this Algerian administrative corpus; reject entries with compound student given names and canonicalized Arabic-script equivalences. Prefer corroborated Algeria-2019 spellings.

sources.title: Country DZ 2019 surname-directory corroboration, Surname Dispersion Dataset (locatefamily.com crawl)
sources.license: MIT repository; upstream directory-data rights unverified
sources.romanization_convention: Administrative French/Latin familyname_fr from primary Algerian corpus is authoritative; title case only for uppercase forms. Directory spellings are used as corroboration, never mechanically applied to Arabic.
sources.selection: Prefer candidates present in both country-specific datasets, then use remaining primary Algerian family-name records; discard source percentages and all weights.
sources.limitations: Only single-word supplemental administrative surname rows selected to reduce student-name contamination. The original 500 retained as-is. All-country coverage and individual civil-register attestation remain unproven.
